You must have a clear symbolic or physical connection: name, token, blood mark, talisman, familiar scent, active formation link, or current line of sight. one_line_description: Prerequisite: CL 12+, Breath Beyond the Skin Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Self Area: 60-foot Emanation Duration: 1 minute Cost: 2 CP Use Limit: Once per short or long rest You establish a court of moving air around yourself. Choose four winds when the court appears: North, South, East, and West. Each wind is assigned one Vector: Lift, Press, Cut, Carry, Turn, or Scatter. You cannot assign the same Vector to more than two winds. For the duration: You may maintain up to four Air Currents without counting them against your Air Control Limit. Once on each of your turns, you may use Gather Current without an action. When a creature starts its turn inside the court, you may move one active Current up to 20 feet. Your Wind Lash may originate from any active Current inside the court. Allied creatures inside one of your Currents gain +10 feet to Speed while moving in the direction you choose. Hostile creatures moving against one of your Currents treat the space as Difficult Terrain. Once per round when an ordinary ranged weapon attack passes through one of your Currents, you may impose Disadvantage on that attack without using your Reaction. The court ends early if you are Incapacitated or if you enter an airless sealed region that prevents currents from existing.

one_line_description: Prerequisite: CL 5+ When a creature within your reach is Grappled, Restrained, bound by chains, vines, ropes, nets, thread, wax, webbing, or a comparable physical restraint, you may use Hewing Strike against the restraint instead of the creature.
full_description: Prerequisite: CL 5+ When a creature within your reach is Grappled, Restrained, bound by chains, vines, ropes, nets, thread, wax, webbing, or a comparable physical restraint, you may use Hewing Strike against the restraint instead of the creature. On hit, deal damage to the restraint. If the attack would destroy, sever, or meaningfully disrupt the restraint, the restrained creature is freed from that restraint. If the restraint is created by a cultivation effect, make an Axes Check against the effect's save DC. On a success, suppress the restraint on that creature until the start of your next turn. On a success by 5 or more, end the restraint on that creature if the effect is not Secret, Domain-scale, or artifact-backed.

Use Limit: Once per month or once per major story arc, as determined by the GM

You claim the burden of a battlefield, valley, mountain pass, city gate, sect courtyard, mine, tomb complex, or other grounded region.

Choose one principle when you activate this inheritance.

#### Nothing Unmoored May Rule

Creatures hostile to you cannot teleport into, teleport out of, burrow through, phase through, or use planar movement through the area unless they succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your Earth Save DC.

On a success, the movement works, but the creature gains one Burden Mark and takes 6d10 Force damage as the world makes it pay the weight of departure.

This does not block deity-scale movement, artifact-scale movement, or GM-declared story-scale passage.

#### The Ground Bears the Innocent

Choose any number of creatures you can name, see, or ritually identify as protected.

While a protected creature touches ground in the area:

it has Advantage on death saving throws;

it cannot be moved against its will by ordinary forced movement;

the first time each minute it would take damage, reduce that damage by 10d10;

if it would be buried, trapped, crushed, or fall into a fissure caused by terrain, move it to the nearest safe ground you choose within 60 feet.

#### The Burden Returns to the Violent

The first time each round that a hostile creature in the area deals damage, forces movement, destroys terrain, collapses a structure, or kills a creature, it gains one Burden Mark.

When you spend that mark, add 5d10 Bludgeoning damage or 5d10 Force damage to the Earth Response.

If the creature is already marked, it instead makes a Strength saving throw.

Failed Save: It falls Prone, its Speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn, and it cannot teleport until the end of its next turn.

Successful Save: It cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

The World Rests on My Palm does not create permanent political ownership, legal title, or divine authority over the region.

It makes the region briefly answer your Dao of foundation and burden.

While the target is not within 5 feet of another creature, it can take the Help action to help itself as a Bonus Action. one_line_description: When you win a Disarm attempt, you may bind the target’s object to your weapon instead of causing the target to drop it. You may also bind a hand, natural weapon, or comparable attacking limb as though it were a held object. While the bind lasts: the target has the Grappled condition; the bound object or limb cannot be used to make attacks; you must remain within the reach of the weapon or Unarmed Strike used to establish the bind; you cannot use the weapon or limb maintaining the bind to make attacks; the bind ends if you become Incapacitated, release it at any time with no Action required, or move beyond the permitted reach. If an object is bound, the target may release that object at any time with no Action required, ending the bind. Otherwise, the target may use its Action to make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against your Cultivation Save DC, ending the bind on a success. Bind Weapon is a special form of Grapple. It does not require a free hand unless the weapon or Unarmed Strike used to establish the bind requires one.

full_description: Action Type: Action Range: 60 feet Target: One door, chest, gate, window, latch, hinge, wheel, lever, or similar object no larger than a 10-foot cube Duration: 1 minute Cost: 1 CP You freeze a mundane mechanism in place. full_description: Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm Action Type: Bonus Action Range: 120 feet Cost: 2 CP Move any number of your Lattice Spaces up to 10 feet each along surfaces they could legally occupy. A Lattice Space cannot move through a creature’s space unless the creature is willing or Incapacitated. A hostile creature whose space is entered by a moving Lattice Space must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be pushed 5 feet in the direction the lattice moved and gain a Fracture Mark. On a success, the creature chooses whether to move 5 feet to an unoccupied adjacent space or allow the lattice to pass harmlessly beneath it.

full_description:
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, White Tiger teacher, killing-edge scripture, execution hall inheritance, or comparable revelation

Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row

Range: Self

Duration: 1 minute

Cost: 3 CP

Use Limit: Once per long rest

You open the White Tiger killing star inside your Metal Qi. Your eyes, breath, weapon, nails, needles, or aura take on a pale cutting radiance. Until the state ends, your Metal talents become Seven-Slaughter expressions.

While the Canon is active, once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a Metal talent, weapon attack carrying Metal Qi, or White Tiger Method talent, choose one slaughter sign:

- **No Mending Under the Star.** The target cannot regain HP or gain Temporary HP until the start of your next turn.
- **Cut the Coward Road.** The target cannot benefit from teleportation, phasing, burrowing, or invisibility to escape you until the start of your next turn unless it succeeds on a Wisdom saving throw.
- **Open the Guard.** The next attack against the target before the start of your next turn gains a bonus to the attack roll equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
- **Sever the Command.** The target cannot grant allies Advantage, command a formation, or issue a battlefield order until the start of your next turn unless it succeeds on a Charisma saving throw.
- **Tiger Eats the Fear.** If the target is Bloodied, it makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is Frightened of you until the start of your next turn.

Once while the Canon is active, when you reduce a meaningful enemy to 0 HP or score a critical hit with a Metal talent, you may immediately regain CP equal to your Proficiency Bonus and end one Frightened or Charmed effect on yourself.

At Nascent Soul Realm, the first slaughter sign you choose each round may affect one additional creature within 30 feet that you damaged with a Metal talent this turn.

This Canon is not subtle. Orthodox witnesses recognize it as a temple-grade or execution-grade killing scripture.

Within the Court: ground spaces of your choice become Shallow Sand Terrain when they enter the Court; as a Bonus Action, you may change a number of Sand Terrain squares in the Court up to your Proficiency Bonus into Deep or Storming Sand Terrain until the start of your next turn; hostile creatures treat all Sand Terrain in the Court as Difficult Terrain; once on each of your turns, you may use Scouring Hand, Sand Drag, Dust Veil, or Dune Bank without spending an Action, Bonus Action, or Reaction; you know the location of any creature touching Sand Terrain in the Court unless it is protected by a stronger concealment, Void effect, or superior stealth technique; when a hostile creature falls Prone, becomes Buried, or fails a saving throw against your Sand talent in the Court, you may move one Sand Terrain square up to 20 feet. If two Domains contest the same area, use the campaign’s Domain conflict rules or an opposed Cultivation Check.

The target must be a battlefield-scale physical feature, a structure, a terrain zone, a formation section with physical anchors, a siege engine, a wall, a bridge, a gate, a vehicle, a mass of troops, or one Huge or larger creature touching a surface. Pure ideas, souls, memories, laws, oaths, and nonphysical effects are not legal targets unless the GM treats them as having a physical anchor.

Resolve one of the following modes.

##### Grind the Shape

A structure, wall, gate, bridge, siege engine, vehicle, or formation anchor section takes 12d10 Force damage. This damage represents supernatural erosion and ignores resistance to nonmagical damage. If this reduces the target to 0 Hit Points or overcomes its threshold, it collapses into Sand Terrain under your control.

If the target is a major formation, artifact-reinforced structure, city wall, sect gate, or scene-defining object, make an opposed Cultivation Check. On a success, suppress or breach one meaningful section for 1 minute instead of automatically destroying the whole target.

##### Bury the Line

Choose a 60-foot-radius ground area. It becomes Deep and Storming Sand Terrain for 1 minute. Hostile creatures of your choice in the area make a Strength saving throw.

On a failed save, a creature is Buried and Restrained for 1 minute. While restrained this way, it is also Blinded by sand unless it does not rely on sight. It may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effects on itself on a success.

On a successful save, it is Buried until the start of your next turn and its Speed becomes 0 until the start of your next turn.

##### Erode the Giant

Choose one Huge or larger creature touching a surface. It makes a Constitution saving throw.

On a failed save, it takes 10d10 Force damage, loses any Burrow Speed or Climb Speed until the end of your next turn, cannot regain Hit Points until the end of your next turn, and falls Prone if it can be knocked Prone.

On a successful save, it takes half damage and cannot regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn.

##### Claim the Desert

For 1 minute, all ground in a 60-foot-radius area becomes your Sand Terrain. You decide whether each square is Shallow, Deep, or Storming whenever a creature starts its turn there. Your Sand Control Limit does not apply to this area for the duration.

Once during each of your turns while the inheritance lasts, you may use Gather Sand, Scouring Hand, Sand Drag, Dune Bank, Dust Veil, or Quicksand Gate in the area without spending an Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, or CP.

When the inheritance ends, created sand collapses into ordinary loose ground or remains as a changed battlefield feature if the GM rules the terrain was permanently altered.

A structure, wall, gate, bridge, siege engine, vehicle, or formation anchor section takes 12d10 Force damage. This damage represents supernatural erosion and ignores resistance to nonmagical damage. If this reduces the target to 0 Hit Points or overcomes its threshold, it collapses into Sand Terrain under your control.

If the target is a major formation, artifact-reinforced structure, city wall, sect gate, or scene-defining object, make an opposed Cultivation Check. On a success, suppress or breach one meaningful section for 1 minute instead of automatically destroying the whole target.

##### Bury the Line

Choose a 60-foot-radius ground area. It becomes Deep and Storming Sand Terrain for 1 minute. Hostile creatures of your choice in the area make a Strength saving throw.

On a failed save, a creature is Buried and Restrained for 1 minute. While restrained this way, it is also Blinded by sand unless it does not rely on sight. It may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effects on itself on a success.

On a successful save, it is Buried until the start of your next turn and its Speed becomes 0 until the start of your next turn.

##### Erode the Giant

Choose one Huge or larger creature touching a surface. It makes a Constitution saving throw.

On a failed save, it takes 10d10 Force damage, loses any Burrow Speed or Climb Speed until the end of your next turn, cannot regain Hit Points until the end of your next turn, and falls Prone if it can be knocked Prone.

On a successful save, it takes half damage and cannot regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn.

##### Claim the Desert

For 1 minute, all ground in a 60-foot-radius area becomes your Sand Terrain. You decide whether each square is Shallow, Deep, or Storming whenever a creature starts its turn there. Your Sand Control Limit does not apply to this area for the duration.

Once during each of your turns while the inheritance lasts, you may use Gather Sand, Scouring Hand, Sand Drag, Dune Bank, Dust Veil, or Quicksand Gate in the area without spending an Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, or CP.

When the inheritance ends, created sand collapses into ordinary loose ground or remains as a changed battlefield feature if the GM rules the terrain was permanently altered.

one_line_description: When a weapon attack misses a creature benefiting from your Active Defense, you may expend Martial Focus.
full_description: When a weapon attack misses a creature benefiting from your Active Defense, you may expend Martial Focus. Choose one new legal target for the attack. For a melee attack, the new target must be within the attacker’s original reach. For a ranged attack, the new target must be within the attack’s original range from the attacker. Compare the original attack roll to the new target’s AC. The attack retains its original damage and effects. Redirecting Shield does not affect siege weapons, massive weapons, area effects, or attacks that cannot legally reach the new target.

full_description:
Secret Water Inheritance

Prerequisite: Ocean-Sovereign Incarnation, CL 17+, hidden oceanic scripture, sea-heart initiation, or equivalent revelation

Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row

Range: 1 mile, centered on a significant Water Source or on yourself during Ocean-Sovereign Incarnation

Area: Up to a 300-foot-radius region chosen by the GM and player according to terrain

Duration: 1 minute

Cost: 8 CP Uses: Once per week

You declare that the battlefield was only temporarily dry.

For the duration, the area becomes a sovereign tide region. It may manifest as floodwater, descending rain-sea, rivers rising from stone, a phantom ocean overlapping reality, or every drop in the area remembering its original sea.

Choose three laws when the inheritance manifests:

No Shore. Hostile creatures treat the area as Difficult Terrain. Allies of your choice ignore this terrain and gain Swim Speed equal to their Speed.

Every Path Returns. Once per round, when a hostile creature moves, teleports, flies, or is forced to move inside the area, you may move it up to 30 feet into a legal space after that movement resolves.

All Fire Drowns. Ordinary flames are extinguished. Fire effects that begin in the area or enter it must succeed on an opposed Cultivation Check or be suppressed until the start of the creator’s next turn.

Pressure Has No Surface. Up to three hostile creatures of your choice each round suffer Drowning Pressure until the start of your next turn.

The River Takes the Weapon. Once per round, when a hostile creature hits with a weapon attack inside the area, reduce the damage by 4d10 and move the attacker or target 30 feet into a legal space.

The Sea Gives Back. Once per round, an ally of your choice inside the area regains Hit Points equal to 4d8 + your Water key ability modifier when it starts its turn Soaked or inside a Water effect.

Mountains Become Silt. Objects, walls, gates, and unattended structures in the area suffer Scouring Erosion. Water damage against them is doubled if mundane and erodible.

When the inheritance ends, choose one final Return:

all allies of your choice in the area move up to 60 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks;

one hostile creature that failed a saving throw against your Water effect during the inheritance is Restrained until the end of your next turn;

one Barrier, gate, or terrain feature damaged by the inheritance gains an Erosion Mark for 24 hours;

one Sacred Spring forms at the center for 24 hours.

This inheritance cannot permanently flood a nation, create an endless sea, override a superior divine or sect formation without contest, or solve regional drought by itself. Those outcomes require campaign-scale projects.

The cultivator tightened one hand and informed Heaven that the discussion was not finished.” Classification: Secret Wrestling Inheritance Prerequisite: CL 17+, Court of the Closed Distance, World-Pinning Clinch, hidden restraint scripture Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Reach Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per week Choose one creature within reach. It makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, choosing which, against your Wrestling Save DC. Failed Save: Until the end of your next turn: the target becomes Grappled and Restrained; ordinary size limits do not apply; the target cannot teleport, travel between planes, or become Incorporeal; the target cannot be moved away from you unless you permit it; apply up to three different Slam talents you know immediately; the target has Disadvantage on saving throws and checks made to escape this hold. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. Successful Initial Save: The target cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. The Hold Heaven Could Not Escape does not automatically overcome: artifacts; Formation cores; Domains; Secret Inheritances; Realm-defining transformations; major narrative entities beyond the scope of ordinary combat. Those may require a contested Cultivation Check or a specific narrative condition.

one_line_description: Prerequisite: Berserker sphere Shatter Earth, Living Weapon, Earth-Shattering Slam, CL 10+ When Earth-Shattering Slam Restrains one target in broken ground, choose to drive it underground. Move the target downward through ordinary soil, stone, wood, or similar material: | Cultivation Level | Maximum Depth | | --- | --- | | 10-16 | 10 feet | | 17-20 | 20 feet | If the path breaks through a floor, roof, or hollow structure, the creature falls normally after emerging. While Restrained underground: the target cannot breathe unless it has an appropriate feature; it suffers the normal 2024 suffocation hazard when it runs out of breath or is choking; escaping the Restrained condition does not automatically remove it from the hole. After escaping, it must still climb, fly, burrow, teleport, or otherwise leave the burial space legally. Tombstone Burial cannot pass through: metal; artifacts; Formation cores; sealed barriers; Realm-defining structures.

one_line_description: Prerequisite: CL 15+ Your grapples may affect creatures up to three sizes larger than you. When you Grapple a creature larger than you: count as attached to the creature rather than automatically moving it; move with that creature when it moves unless an effect removes you; the creature cannot move you through a space too small for you; the creature has Disadvantage on attacks made against creatures other than you; you may apply Slam talents normally. If a feature increases your effective size, apply that increase before World-Pinning Clinch.

full_description: Action Type: No Action Trigger: You spend a Waning Mark from a creature that spoke, shouted, used a verbal spell component, issued a command, or activated a sound-based technique during the current turn Cost: 1 CP The target’s voice trails into stillness. This does not prevent verbal components by itself. At Foundation Realm, you may take Silence Receives the Name to make this effect stronger.

one_line_description: Action Type: Ritual Time: 10 minutes Range: Touch Duration: Until your next Long Rest Cost: 10 CP Touch a corpse, severed limb, destroyed construct, broken talisman, shattered weapon, spent Formation node, or collapsed spiritual remnant.
full_description: Action Type: Ritual Time: 10 minutes Range: Touch Duration: Until your next Long Rest Cost: 10 CP Touch a corpse, severed limb, destroyed construct, broken talisman, shattered weapon, spent Formation node, or collapsed spiritual remnant. You preserve its final state and draw one answer from the stillness. Ask the GM one question about the subject’s final hour, final injury, final technique, final owner, final command, final emotion, final destination, or final visible enemy. The answer must be brief but truthful from the subject’s available traces. This does not speak with the dead, summon a soul, compel a spirit, or reveal information the subject left no trace of knowing.

one_line_description: Action Type: Action Range: 60 feet Area: 15-foot-radius sphere Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 2 CP You create an area of inward-turning breath, cold haze, and spiritual quiet.
full_description: Action Type: Action Range: 60 feet Area: 15-foot-radius sphere Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 2 CP You create an area of inward-turning breath, cold haze, and spiritual quiet. The area is Lightly Obscured. When a creature inside the area gains a Waning Mark, you may choose for the area to become Heavily Obscured for that creature until the start of your next turn. This heavier concealment represents the world withdrawing from the marked creature’s attention; it does not automatically make any creature Hidden. A creature with Blindsight, Truesight, or an appropriate revealing technique may ignore this concealment within that sense or technique’s range.

one_line_description: Action Type: Bonus Action Range: Self Duration: Until the end of the current turn Cost: 2 CP Until the end of your turn, you can move through spaces occupied by marked creatures, and marked creatures cannot make Opportunity Attacks against you.
full_description: Action Type: Bonus Action Range: Self Duration: Until the end of the current turn Cost: 2 CP Until the end of your turn, you can move through spaces occupied by marked creatures, and marked creatures cannot make Opportunity Attacks against you. If you spend a Waning Mark during this movement, you may move through one solid object or barrier no more than 5 feet thick. This movement is not teleportation. If you end your turn inside an object, you are shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and take 2d10 Force damage. This feature cannot pass through a ward, Formation, Barrier, or sealed boundary designed to block incorporeal or spiritual movement unless your CL exceeds the effect’s CL or the GM rules otherwise.
